title: Visual Novel Text to Speech interface map

contracts.app-shell: Keep Stories, Voices and Reading as the ordinary application navigation; setup and support remain secondary.
contracts.single-mission: Give each surface one primary mission and one visually dominant next action.
contracts.responsive-form: Let value controls use available width, wrap long rows and keep utility buttons content-sized.
contracts.runtime-controls: Use the same live-reading capabilities, labels and disabled reasons in dashboard, compact controls and tray.
contracts.voice-selection: Use one voice editor for general assignment and live recovery; recovery preselects the role without changing the workflow.
contracts.global-settings: Keep engine, model and application-wide behavior in Settings rather than per-role editors.
contracts.playback-evidence: Place playback beside the recording it plays and distinguish original audio from generated preview.
contracts.review-authority: State the evidence, decision scope and consequence before an authoritative review action.
contracts.support-boundary: Keep diagnostics and support export out of ordinary task flows unless recovery requires them.

surfaces.title: Application dashboard
surfaces.mission: Move between story preparation, voice choices and live reading while seeing current application state.

stories.title: Stories ready
stories.state: Ready to prepare or open reading

stories.title: Reading active
stories.state: Recognized dialogue with usable transport controls

stories.title: Setup navigation expanded
stories.state: Settings and other secondary destinations are visible

surfaces.title: Narrator and character voices
surfaces.mission: Choose one role, compare its original reference with a generated preview and save the voice assignment.

stories.title: Narrator assignment
stories.state: Normal entry from the Voices tab

stories.title: Unknown speaker recovery
stories.state: Same editor with the missing character preselected

stories.title: Preview generation
stories.state: Progress, cancellation and playback ownership are visible

stories.title: Preview generation failure
stories.state: Failure explains recovery without implying that a voice was assigned

stories.title: Long content at compact width
stories.state: Long roles, references and transcripts remain usable

stories.title: Saved assignment return
stories.state: The saved role and return destination are visibly confirmed

surfaces.title: Settings
surfaces.mission: Change application-wide capture, speech, playback and behavior settings.

stories.title: Invalid speech settings
stories.state: Save is blocked with a focused actionable explanation

surfaces.title: Compact controls
surfaces.mission: Control live reading without covering the game.

surfaces.title: Background tray menu
surfaces.mission: Show short status, essential transport and escape actions while the application is in the background.

surfaces.title: Unknown speaker recovery
surfaces.mission: Pause an unresolved live line and route the user into the canonical voice editor.

stories.title: Speaker recovery choice
stories.state: Choose a voice, use narrator for this session, or pause live reading

surfaces.title: Live voice preflight
surfaces.mission: Confirm that live reading has usable voices before starting.

surfaces.title: First-run setup
surfaces.mission: Guide a first-time user from welcome through configuration, diagnostics, calibration and a complete test.

surfaces.title: Readiness check
surfaces.mission: Explain what prevents reading and offer the exact next remediation.

surfaces.title: Capture calibration
surfaces.mission: Select and verify the dialogue capture region.

surfaces.title: Game profiles
surfaces.mission: Save, activate and remove complete game-specific configurations.

surfaces.title: Speech assets
surfaces.mission: Install only the model assets required by the active speech engine.

surfaces.title: Voice import
surfaces.mission: Add a verified external voice reference to the reusable voice library.

surfaces.title: macOS permissions
surfaces.mission: Show required permission state and route to the relevant system control.

surfaces.title: Offline story preparation
surfaces.mission: Choose stories, prepare durable audio and understand progress, recovery and activation.

stories.title: Finding game content
stories.state: Discovery runs without exposing unusable controls

stories.title: Choose stories
stories.state: Detected source, persisted selection and preparation estimate

stories.title: Confirm voice routes
stories.state: Selected stories, narrator and automatic substitutions are reviewable before generation

stories.title: Partially ready
stories.state: Durable progress and playable chapter readiness remain visible during generation

stories.title: Resumable failure
stories.state: Failure explains what was kept and the exact retry action

stories.title: Preparation complete
stories.state: Saved coverage and a deferred activation consequence are explicit

surfaces.title: Preparation voice audition
surfaces.mission: Compare an automatic story voice choice without changing the global assignment unless requested.

surfaces.title: Uncertain OCR review
surfaces.mission: Correct one uncertain captured line and save a scoped rule only when content changed.

surfaces.title: OCR corrections
surfaces.mission: Inspect and edit stored OCR correction rules and their scope.

surfaces.title: Dialogue history
surfaces.mission: Find and replay a previously spoken line.

surfaces.title: Live diagnostics
surfaces.mission: Inspect the latest capture and runtime evidence and take one contextual remediation action.

surfaces.title: Support and logs
surfaces.mission: Collect bounded diagnostics, export a support archive and open the settings location.

surfaces.title: Authoring workbench
surfaces.mission: Inspect generation state, run selected generation and repair individual outcomes.

surfaces.title: Cohort review
surfaces.mission: Hear a checksum-bound sample set and make one cohort decision.

surfaces.title: Missing voice and failed line review
surfaces.mission: Choose explicit fallbacks for missing voices and exhausted generated lines.

surfaces.title: Failed reference audit
surfaces.mission: Select source audio suitable for cloning one failed speaker group.

surfaces.title: Source reference quality
surfaces.mission: Judge original and generated evidence for one source reference.

surfaces.title: Blind A/B listening
surfaces.mission: Compare hidden A/B audio and record one blinded preference.

surfaces.title: Terminal conflict review
surfaces.mission: Resolve two contradictory historical terminal decisions without guessing from metadata.

surfaces.title: Source voice mapping
surfaces.mission: Review extracted source clips and assign stable speaker identities.

surfaces.title: Character Story reference review
surfaces.mission: Compare valid same-character source references and retain protected notes and decisions.

surfaces.title: Background mode notification
surfaces.mission: Confirm that the application remains active after its window closes.

surfaces.title: Unmapped speaker notification
surfaces.mission: Draw bounded attention to paused speaker recovery without duplicating a visible prompt.

surfaces.title: Critical error notification
surfaces.mission: Report a bounded privacy-safe failure and route to the owning recovery surface.
